depiction.primary_object: open laptop computer with screen and base

readings.meaning: remote work / digital task on computer

ambiguity: Could slightly resemble a tablet in a dock or a portable DVD player at very small sizes, though the wider bottom lip clearly reads as a laptop.

Compare refurbished 14-inch MacBook Pro prices on BackMarket
Back up main SSD to the external Time Machine drive
Drop off the loaned Latitude at the IT helpdesk
Apply matte anti-glare film before working from the patio
Test webcam and microphone permissions in Chrome before tomorrow's panel
Replace swollen battery in Mom's old HP pavilion
Set up a separate user account on the family Chromebook for Leo's schoolwork
Clear out 40GB of old Xcode caches and raw video files from the Downloads folder
Record the serial number and purchase receipt in the home insurance spreadsheet before flying
Calibrate the display color profile with the borrowed SpyderX sensor before editing client photos

reasoning: A clear, universally recognizable front-facing open laptop icon. It is ideal for tasks centered on a portable computer (buying, repairing, backing up, cleaning, configuring) and serves well as a secondary fallback for general computer-based digital chores, though it should not replace more specific icons like email, documents, or desktop monitors.
